items.title: Purpose
items.body: This rulebook sets out the rules for borrowing items from the Riverside Tool Library. It applies to every member.

items.title: Purpose
items.body: The rules aim to keep tools available, safe and in good repair for all members.

items.title: Membership
items.body: A person must be 18 or over and show proof of address to become a member.

items.title: Membership
items.body: Membership lasts 12 months from the date of joining and may be renewed in the final month.

items.title: Loan periods
items.body: A member may borrow a power tool for up to 3 days.

items.title: Loan periods
items.body: A member may borrow a hand tool for up to 14 days.

items.title: Loan periods
items.body: Staff may shorten a loan period in busy seasons, such as spring, when demand for garden tools is high.

items.title: Borrowing limits
items.body: A member must not hold more than 5 items at the same time.

items.title: Renewals
items.body: A loan may be renewed once, provided no other member has reserved the item.

items.title: Late returns
items.body: A late fee of 50p per item per day applies after the due date, capped at 10 pounds per item.

items.title: Late returns
items.body: Staff should waive late fees where a member was prevented from returning an item by illness.

items.title: Damage
items.body: A member must report any damage to an item when returning it.

items.title: Damage
items.body: Normal wear, such as blunt blades, is not treated as damage.

items.title: Safety
items.body: A member must complete the safety induction before borrowing a chainsaw or an angle grinder.

items.title: Safety
items.body: Protective goggles are lent free of charge with every power tool and must be returned with it.
